sender.en: A new online lover or friend, often with a fake profile

name.en: Sextortion: an online lover gets intimate photos, then threatens to leak them unless you pay

how.en: Someone you meet on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or a dating app builds a romance or friendship and moves the chat to WhatsApp. They persuade you to send intimate photos or videos, or fake them with AI. Then they demand money, often in dollars or crypto, and threaten to send the images to your family, church or colleagues. Paying usually brings more demands.

text.en: A new online contact quickly becomes romantic and moves to WhatsApp.
They ask for intimate photos or videos, or a video call.
They demand money and threaten to post the images or send them to your contacts.
I have your videos and the list of your followers and family. Send $800 before 8pm or I will post everything on your page and send to your pastor. Don’t try me.

en: threatening to leak my nude pictures unless i pay
he said he will send my videos to my family
online lover demanding money or he posts my pictures
pay or i will release your intimate video
fake profile collected my photos and is blackmailing me
An online lover you have never met asking for intimate images.
Threats to share images with your family or followers.
Demands for money, gift cards or crypto with a deadline.
Do not pay or send more images; stop replying but do not delete the chat.
Save screenshots of the messages, usernames and payment details, then block and report the account on the platform.
Report to the NPF-NCCC. You are the victim; it is a crime against you.
